objective: Decide whether the non-discoverable agentkit candidate is safe and useful for collecting real E2E maturity evidence.
baseline: direct invocation of the ten individual-agent donor skills

environment.runtime: python-3 deterministic fixtures plus official skill validator

criteria.structure: official validator passes and all resources resolve
criteria.routing: explicit agentkit invocations route while direct specialist, team and metaskill requests do not
criteria.behavior: command contracts name observable outputs and preserve donor boundaries
criteria.scripts-tools: status, E2E scaffold, router fixture, false-completion and approval paths pass
criteria.security-authority: canonical and vendored donors remain read-only and prompt generation fails without matching approval
criteria.coexistence: candidate is absent from all discovery, catalog and generated plugin surfaces
criteria.lifecycle: maturity ledger declares experimental non-discoverable status and blocks premature promotion

holdout_policy.rule: Bundled cases are public regression fixtures; do not store answer-bearing pack holdout in the candidate.

execution_policy.side_effects: temporary fixture directories and repository candidate files only
